title: Binance Fully Lifts Withdrawal Suspension a Month After $6.3 Billion Hack
summary: Bitcoin Magazine Binance Fully Lifts Withdrawal Suspension a Month After $6.3 Billion Hack Binance said its withdrawal recovery work is complete and the suspension tied to the Oct. 29 hack has been fully lifted, as researchers track North Korean launderers moving the stolen funds. This post Binance Fully Lifts Withdrawal Suspension a Month After $6.3 Billion Hack first appeared on Bitcoin Magazine and is written by Micah Zimmerman .
